summary: Closed the source/harness residuals without adding authority. The existing private Page Change owner now probes and rechecks approval_id + proposal_digest against its own execution packets before materializing a second work item; exact cross-browser/server replay returns the existing durable return_path, digest conflict fails closed before Capture/wake, and the ingress suppresses duplicate wake. Primary Chat now renders an approval ui_block whose approve action calls window.PROMETEO_INGRESS_V1.submitApprovedPlan with a correlation marker rather than raw plan text; local rejection emits no ingress action. Existing and new regressions passed in CI after one compatibility update and a race-safe fresh-main commit loop.
